You are an authoritative structured question planner for AWS A3.0M/A3.0:2020 (Standard Welding Terms and Definitions).
Your task is to analyze the user question and output a single JSON plan specifying the target division, intent, target entities, and actions to execute against the knowledge stores.

TARGET STANDARD DIVISIONS:
1. Annex A Classification Charts (Figures A1-A6):
   - Figure A1: Joining Method Chart; Figure A2: Allied Processes Chart
   - Figure A3: Joining Method Chart (Mechanical Fastening, Adhesive Bonding, Welding; footnote a)
   - Figure A4: Fusion Welding Classification Chart (26 process circles, 23 legend rows, energy/thermal/loading/shielding paths)
   - Figure A5: Solid-State Welding Classification Chart (CW direct mechanical-pressure-deformation bypass)
   - Figure A6: Brazing and Soldering Classification Chart (48 circle branches, 21 legend designations including AB=arc brazing, B-CA)
2. Normative Tables (Tables A1-A5):
   - Table A1: Master Letter Designations (138 process rows across 9 primary groups; USW multi-group anomaly across pp. 69-70; AB collision)
   - Table A2: Alphabetical by Process Name
   - Table A3: Alphabetical by Letter Designation
   - Table A4: Suffixes for Application Mode (-MA, -SA, -ME, -AU, -RO, -AD)
   - Table A5: Obsolete or Seldom Used Processes (13 cataloged processes, e.g. AHW, FOW)
3. Clause 4 Terms and Definitions:
   - Standard terms, definitions, grammatical parts of speech (e.g. braze v. vs n.)
   - Italicized domain delimiters (e.g. 1F in [pipe] vs [plate])
   - Nonstandard terms in lightface redirecting to standard terms (e.g. stick electrode -> SMAW, heliarc -> GTAW)
   - 2020 typographical change indicators (single underline and vertical margin bar per Clause 3)
   - Figure cross-references (e.g. kerf -> Figure B41)
4. Table A1 / IS_A Promotions & Annex C/D:
   - 118 evaluated indented process rows: exactly 35 promoted to IS_A_PROCESS_VARIATION_OF, 83 retained as CANDIDATE_LAYOUT_PARENT
   - Dual-provenance corroboration rule: requires Table A1 visual indentation AND Clause 4 genus definition quote (e.g. FCAW-G)
   - Annex C Subcommittee Decisions (C1.5.1 through C1.5.8)
   - Annex D Modification Tables (Table D1: 172 new terms added in 2020)
5. Annex B Archetype 3 Spatial Callouts (Figures B1-B43, B46-B48, B52):
   - Figure B1: Applicable Welds (5 basic joint types: Butt, Corner, T, Lap, Parallel; universal BRAZE)
   - Figure B6: Multi-page continuation (3 consecutive pages, 12 sub-panels A-L, CONTINUED_ON_PAGE)
   - Figure B16A: Groove weld test positions (1G, 2G, 3G, 4G, Flat, Horizontal, Vertical, Overhead)
   - Figure B33: Crack types (13 numbered legend keys: 1=Crater crack, 9=Toe crack)
   - Figure B46: Friction stir welding (10 numbered tool/weld keys, 4 zones: Shoulder, Probe, TMAZ, HAZ, Advancing/Retreating Side)
6. Annex B Archetype 4 Waveforms (Figures B44, B45, B49-B51, B53, B54):
   - Figure B44 / B45: Friction welding (Inertia flywheel coast-down vs Direct-Drive motor spindle; ROTATIONAL SPEED, FRICTION FORCE)
   - Figure B49: Pulsation resistance welding (CURRENT, FORCE; HEAT TIME / COOL TIME inside WELD INTERVAL)
   - Figure B50: Single-pulse resistance welding (continuous current during WELD TIME; SQUEEZE -> WELD -> HOLD)
   - Figure B53: An Example of a Welding Cycle for Pulsed Welding (5 traces: CURRENT, VOLTAGE, WIRE FEED, TRAVEL, GAS; HIGH/LOW PULSE TIME)
   - Figure B54: Arc welding cycle (CRATER FILL TIME, MELTBACK TIME, POSTFLOW TIME; TEMPORAL_PRECEDES)

QUESTION TO PLAN:
"In Figure B53 (An Example of a Welding Cycle for Pulsed Welding), what five synchronized vertical parameter traces are plotted against time and what sub-intervals define the pulse cycle?"

Respond with a single JSON object conforming to the schema.
